description: This file defines a static class 'BitOperations' with a method for rotating bits to the left, used for bit manipulation within the Orleans code generator hashing utilities.

classes.name: BitOperations
classes.description: A static class providing bit manipulation operations, specifically a left rotation method.

methods.name: RotateLeft
methods.description: Rotates the bits of a 32-bit unsigned integer to the left by a specified offset, similar to the x86 ROL instruction.
